# Above All Tent and Party Rentals

## Business Overview
Above All Tent and Party Rentals is a professional tent and event rental company based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. We provide high-quality tent rentals and event equipment for weddings, backyard parties, corporate events, and festivals across Calgary and surrounding areas.

## Contact Information
- Phone: 403-493-3128
- Secondary: 778-955-9402
- Location: Calgary, Alberta, Canada
- Service Area: Calgary and surrounding Alberta communities

## Services

### Tent Rentals
We offer a wide range of tent sizes and styles suitable for any event size, from intimate gatherings to large-scale festivals. All tents are heavy-duty, weather-resistant, and professionally installed.

### Wedding Tents
Elegant tent solutions for outdoor weddings. We provide full setup and teardown, with options for sidewalls, flooring, lighting, and climate control to create a beautiful, comfortable venue.

### Party Tents
Backyard party tent rentals for birthdays, graduations, family reunions, and casual celebrations. Available in multiple sizes to fit any yard or outdoor space.

### Festival Tents
Large-format tent structures for festivals, fairs, markets, and community events. Engineered for durability and crowd capacity.

## Rental Inventory
- Frame tents and pole tents in various sizes
- Sidewalls (solid and window panels)
- Flooring and subflooring
- Tables and chairs
- Lighting (string lights, chandeliers, uplighting)
- Climate control (heaters, fans, air conditioning)
- Décor accessories

## Key Differentiators
- Professional delivery, setup, and teardown included
- Fully insured operations
- Experienced team with years of event experience in Calgary
- Available 7 days a week
- Free quotes provided

## Frequently Asked Questions
- Q: Do you deliver and set up the tents? A: Yes, professional delivery, setup, and teardown is included with every rental.
- Q: How far in advance should I book? A: We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks in advance for peak season (May–September), and 2–3 weeks for off-season events.
- Q: Are your tents suitable for Calgary weather? A: Yes, all our tents are heavy-duty and designed to handle Alberta weather conditions including wind and rain.
- Q: Do you serve areas outside Calgary? A: Yes, we serve Calgary and surrounding communities throughout Alberta.
- Q: How do I get a quote? A: Call us at 403-493-3128 or fill out the contact form on our website.
